author: GitHub
description:
Get to your draft PR even faster by onboarding to the GitHub Copilot for Jira integration. In this quick walkthrough, we show you how to install the app from the Atlassian Marketplace and authorize your GitHub account. We also cover how to handle Single Sign-On (SSO) and manage your enabled organizations. Watch how easy it is to assign a Jira work item to Copilot and automatically create a pull request. 

#GitHubCopilot #Jira #Automation
